module: Baking to DAE files and management of the Edit/Live state of a Hero Road Editor group. The bake writes the group's driving mesh to <level>/art/heroRoad/heroRoad_<id>/heroRoad_<id>_NNN.dae, then puts the group in the disabled (Live) state, where a persistent TSStatic (canSave=true) replaces the editable ProceduralMesh. It also "burns" sidewalks and furniture (sidewalkMgr, barrierMgr) and makes the decals persistent (layerMgr).
notes: The state is driven by group.isEnabled: true = Edit (transient procedural surface, nothing is written to the level), false = Live (baked static, persistent).

The vertices are written relative to each chunk's AABB center and the TSStatic is placed at that center, to keep small local coordinates even far from the world origin (2048 m engine limit cited in the code).
The baked statics are named 'HeroRoadBaked_<id>_<n>' (n starting at 1); collisionType 'Collision Mesh', decalType 'Visible Mesh Final'.
Default chunk length: group.chunkLenM or 120 m.
For a terrain road (group.isMesh == false) no DAE is written; terrainFinalized replaces the manifest.
The current level is obtained by getMissionPath(); with no level loaded, bakeGroup fails.

applyState.desc: Reconciles the group's mesh with its Edit/Live state. Edit: deletes the baked static and the burned pieces, makes decals and folder transient, marks the group dirty (rebuild). Live: deletes the procedural surface and the preview, makes the baked static appear, makes decals and folder persistent, and reloads the collision (be:reloadCollision). If a Live group has no valid bake (or if the .dae files have disappeared), it goes back to Edit. This is also the level save separation: only a Live road is written.

bakeGroup.desc: Bakes the group: generates the chunks with LODs and collision mesh (mesh.buildChunkLODs), empties the bake folder, writes the DAEs (daeExport.writeDaeLODs), burns sidewalks and furniture, sets group.isEnabled=false then calls applyState.

group.desc: Hero Road group with at least 2 nodes.

returns.desc: Result or error message (e.g. 'need at least 2 nodes', 'no level loaded...', 'mesh has no geometry', 'write failed: <path>').

hasBaked.desc: Indicates whether the group has a bake (final state displayable in disabled mode): terrainFinalized for a terrain road, otherwise a non-empty bakedManifest.

unbakeGroup.desc: Cancels the bake: the only way to leave the Live state. Sets isEnabled=true, calls applyState, then clears bakedManifest and terrainFinalized. The DAE files are only deleted at the next bake (wipeFolder).
